#### Full job description

**Already Part of Team Breeze?** Current Breeze Airways Team Members should apply through the internal careers site in Workday and **_should not submit_** an application through this external posting.

Breeze is hiring- join us!


Are you a motivated, passionate, self-starter that thrives in fast paced environments and lives to make a direct impact on the bottom line? Does the idea of working with a bunch of creative, fun, Seriously Nice marketers to help build the nation’s newest and nicest low-fare airline get you excited? If you enthusiastically answered “Yes!” to the above, then you might just be the person we’re looking for. The Breeze Marketing Team is in search of a Paid Media Specialist to help develop, optimize, and report on digital marketing campaigns across display, paid search, paid social, and more as we expand to more cities across the U.S. and beyond. The role comes with a lot of room to grow and the opportunity to learn from a team of performance marketing experts. And did we mention the travel benefits?


# **Here’s what you’ll do**

- Lead the development and implementation of digital advertising programs across paid media channels (social, display, video, search, etc.) while aligning with Marketing team KPIs
- Support upper-funnel programs (audio, CTV, native, etc.) that build brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences that convert to bookings
- Manage paid campaign strategy and budgets for Breeze and Airport Partners
- Track campaign performance and maintain comprehensive reports to provide clear view of program KPIs
- Partner with creative team to develop assets that drive brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences resulting in conversions and bookings
- Proactively leverage revenue data and industry trends to identify and test new channel, segmentation, and revenue opportunities
- Strategize and execute testing initiatives in areas such as creative assets, messaging, and targeting tactics to improve performance
- Assist with email marketing and website optimization when necessary
- Achieve performance measures and adhere to established standards in conjunction with Breeze Aviation Group Values of Safety, Kindness, Integrity, Ingenuity, and Excellence

# **Here’s what you need to be successful**

**Minimum Qualifications**

- 4-year degree in Marketing, Advertising, or related fields
- 2+ years of digital marketing experience with proven and measurable impact to established goals and KPIs
- 2+ years paid search/paid social experience (Google Ads/Facebook Ads)
- 2+ years experience with digital marketing reporting and analytics
- Interest in new technology, particularly AI and automation, and how it can improve marketing performance.
- Comfortable with topics such as budgeting, bidding, and testing methodology
- Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management skills.
- Strong oral and written communications skills.
- Self-starter must have a positive attitude and strong desire for success.
- Complete projects on time with minimal supervision, ability to work varied hours when necessary to meet deadlines

## **Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience improving marketing performance in new technology- particularly AI and automation.


## **Skills/Talents**

- Strong sense of paid media fundamentals
- Strong sense of analytical and reporting skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel
- Exemplifies Breeze’s safety culture, values, and mission
- Ability to work with individuals and teams at all levels in the organization

## **Physical Demands & Working Conditions**

- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
- Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, handling documents, and operating standard office equipment
- Occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds
- Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching within an office environment
- Clear verbal and written communication, requiring adequate speech, hearing, and vision

## **Perks of the Job**

- Health, Vision and Dental – Full Time
- Health Savings Account with Breeze Employee Match
- 401K with Breeze Employee Match
- Generous PTO
- Travel on Breeze and other Airlines too!

#### Full job description

**Already Part of Team Breeze?** Current Breeze Airways Team Members should apply through the internal careers site in Workday and **_should not submit_** an application through this external posting.

Breeze is hiring- join us!


Are you a motivated, passionate, self-starter that thrives in fast paced environments and lives to make a direct impact on the bottom line? Does the idea of working with a bunch of creative, fun, Seriously Nice marketers to help build the nation’s newest and nicest low-fare airline get you excited? If you enthusiastically answered “Yes!” to the above, then you might just be the person we’re looking for. The Breeze Marketing Team is in search of a Paid Media Specialist to help develop, optimize, and report on digital marketing campaigns across display, paid search, paid social, and more as we expand to more cities across the U.S. and beyond. The role comes with a lot of room to grow and the opportunity to learn from a team of performance marketing experts. And did we mention the travel benefits?


# **Here’s what you’ll do**

- Lead the development and implementation of digital advertising programs across paid media channels (social, display, video, search, etc.) while aligning with Marketing team KPIs
- Support upper-funnel programs (audio, CTV, native, etc.) that build brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences that convert to bookings
- Manage paid campaign strategy and budgets for Breeze and Airport Partners
- Track campaign performance and maintain comprehensive reports to provide clear view of program KPIs
- Partner with creative team to develop assets that drive brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences resulting in conversions and bookings
- Proactively leverage revenue data and industry trends to identify and test new channel, segmentation, and revenue opportunities
- Strategize and execute testing initiatives in areas such as creative assets, messaging, and targeting tactics to improve performance
- Assist with email marketing and website optimization when necessary
- Achieve performance measures and adhere to established standards in conjunction with Breeze Aviation Group Values of Safety, Kindness, Integrity, Ingenuity, and Excellence

# **Here’s what you need to be successful**

**Minimum Qualifications**

- 4-year degree in Marketing, Advertising, or related fields
- 2+ years of digital marketing experience with proven and measurable impact to established goals and KPIs
- 2+ years paid search/paid social experience (Google Ads/Facebook Ads)
- 2+ years experience with digital marketing reporting and analytics
- Interest in new technology, particularly AI and automation, and how it can improve marketing performance.
- Comfortable with topics such as budgeting, bidding, and testing methodology
- Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management skills.
- Strong oral and written communications skills.
- Self-starter must have a positive attitude and strong desire for success.
- Complete projects on time with minimal supervision, ability to work varied hours when necessary to meet deadlines

## **Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience improving marketing performance in new technology- particularly AI and automation.


## **Skills/Talents**

- Strong sense of paid media fundamentals
- Strong sense of analytical and reporting skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel
- Exemplifies Breeze’s safety culture, values, and mission
- Ability to work with individuals and teams at all levels in the organization

## **Physical Demands & Working Conditions**

- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
- Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, handling documents, and operating standard office equipment
- Occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds
- Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching within an office environment
- Clear verbal and written communication, requiring adequate speech, hearing, and vision

## **Perks of the Job**

- Health, Vision and Dental – Full Time
- Health Savings Account with Breeze Employee Match
- 401K with Breeze Employee Match
- Generous PTO
- Travel on Breeze and other Airlines too!

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

The Breeze Marketing Team is in search of a Paid Media Specialist to help develop, optimize, and report on digital marketing campaigns across display, paid search, paid social, and more as we expand to more cities across the U.S. and beyond. The role comes with a lot of room to grow and the opportunity to learn from a team of performance marketing experts. And did we mention the travel benefits?


# **Here’s what you’ll do**

- Lead the development and implementation of digital advertising programs across paid media channels (social, display, video, search, etc.) while aligning with Marketing team KPIs
- Support upper-funnel programs (audio, CTV, native, etc.) that build brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences that convert to bookings
- Manage paid campaign strategy and budgets for Breeze and Airport Partners
- Track campaign performance and maintain comprehensive reports to provide clear view of program KPIs
- Partner with creative team to develop assets that drive brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences resulting in conversions and bookings
- Proactively leverage revenue data and industry trends to identify and test new channel, segmentation, and revenue opportunities
- Strategize and execute testing initiatives in areas such as creative assets, messaging, and targeting tactics to improve performance
- Assist with email marketing and website optimization when necessary
- Achieve performance measures and adhere to established standards in conjunction with Breeze Aviation Group Values of Safety, Kindness, Integrity, Ingenuity, and Excellence

# **Here’s what you need to be successful**

**Minimum Qualifications**

- 4-year degree in Marketing, Advertising, or related fields
- 2+ years of digital marketing experience with proven and measurable impact to established goals and KPIs
- 2+ years paid search/paid social experience (Google Ads/Facebook Ads)
- 2+ years experience with digital marketing reporting and analytics
- Interest in new technology, particularly AI and automation, and how it can improve marketing performance.
- Comfortable with topics such as budgeting, bidding, and testing methodology
- Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management skills.
- Strong oral and written communications skills.
- Self-starter must have a positive attitude and strong desire for success.
- Complete projects on time with minimal supervision, ability to work varied hours when necessary to meet deadlines

## **Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience improving marketing performance in new technology- particularly AI and automation.


## **Skills/Talents**

- Strong sense of paid media fundamentals
- Strong sense of analytical and reporting skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel
- Exemplifies Breeze’s safety culture, values, and mission
- Ability to work with individuals and teams at all levels in the organization

## **Physical Demands & Working Conditions**

- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
- Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, handling documents, and operating standard office equipment
- Occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds
- Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching within an office environment
- Clear verbal and written communication, requiring adequate speech, hearing, and vision

## **Perks of the Job**

- Health, Vision and Dental – Full Time
- Health Savings Account with Breeze Employee Match
- 401K with Breeze Employee Match
- Generous PTO
- Travel on Breeze and other Airlines too!

<div>
 <p><b>Already Part of Team Breeze?</b> Current Breeze Airways Team Members should apply through the internal careers site in Workday and <b><i>should not submit</i></b> an application through this external posting.</p>
 <br>
 <p></p> Breeze is hiring- join us! 
 <br>
 <br>
  Are you a motivated, passionate, self-starter that thrives in fast paced environments and lives to make a direct impact on the bottom line? Does the idea of working with a bunch of creative, fun, Seriously Nice marketers to help build the nation’s newest and nicest low-fare airline get you excited? If you enthusiastically answered “Yes!” to the above, then you might just be the person we’re looking for. The Breeze Marketing Team is in search of a Paid Media Specialist to help develop, optimize, and report on digital marketing campaigns across display, paid search, paid social, and more as we expand to more cities across the U.S. and beyond. The role comes with a lot of room to grow and the opportunity to learn from a team of performance marketing experts. And did we mention the travel benefits? 
 <h1><b> Here’s what you’ll do</b></h1>
 <ul>
  <li>Lead the development and implementation of digital advertising programs across paid media channels (social, display, video, search, etc.) while aligning with Marketing team KPIs</li>
  <li>Support upper-funnel programs (audio, CTV, native, etc.) that build brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences that convert to bookings</li>
  <li>Manage paid campaign strategy and budgets for Breeze and Airport Partners</li>
  <li>Track campaign performance and maintain comprehensive reports to provide clear view of program KPIs</li>
  <li>Partner with creative team to develop assets that drive brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences resulting in conversions and bookings</li>
  <li>Proactively leverage revenue data and industry trends to identify and test new channel, segmentation, and revenue opportunities</li>
  <li>Strategize and execute testing initiatives in areas such as creative assets, messaging, and targeting tactics to improve performance</li>
  <li>Assist with email marketing and website optimization when necessary</li>
  <li>Achieve performance measures and adhere to established standards in conjunction with Breeze Aviation Group Values of Safety, Kindness, Integrity, Ingenuity, and Excellence</li>
 </ul>
 <h1><b> Here’s what you need to be successful</b></h1>
 <p><b> Minimum Qualifications</b></p>
 <ul>
  <li>4-year degree in Marketing, Advertising, or related fields</li>
  <li>2+ years of digital marketing experience with proven and measurable impact to established goals and KPIs</li>
  <li>2+ years paid search/paid social experience (Google Ads/Facebook Ads)</li>
  <li>2+ years experience with digital marketing reporting and analytics</li>
  <li>Interest in new technology, particularly AI and automation, and how it can improve marketing performance.</li>
  <li>Comfortable with topics such as budgeting, bidding, and testing methodology</li>
  <li>Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management skills.</li>
  <li>Strong oral and written communications skills.</li>
  <li>Self-starter must have a positive attitude and strong desire for success.</li>
  <li>Complete projects on time with minimal supervision, ability to work varied hours when necessary to meet deadlines</li>
 </ul>
 <h2><b><br>
    Preferred Qualifications</b></h2>
 <ul>
  <li>Experience improving marketing performance in new technology- particularly AI and automation.<br></li>
 </ul>
 <h2><b> Skills/Talents</b></h2>
 <ul>
  <li>Strong sense of paid media fundamentals</li>
  <li>Strong sense of analytical and reporting skills.</li>
  <li>Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel</li>
  <li>Exemplifies Breeze’s safety culture, values, and mission</li>
  <li>Ability to work with individuals and teams at all levels in the organization</li>
 </ul>
 <h2><b><br>
    Physical Demands & Working Conditions</b></h2>
 <ul>
  <li>Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer</li>
  <li>Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, handling documents, and operating standard office equipment</li>
  <li>Occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds</li>
  <li>Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching within an office environment</li>
  <li>Clear verbal and written communication, requiring adequate speech, hearing, and vision</li>
 </ul>
 <h2><b><br>
    Perks of the Job</b></h2>
 <ul>
  <li>Health, Vision and Dental – Full Time</li>
  <li>Health Savings Account with Breeze Employee Match</li>
  <li>401K with Breeze Employee Match</li>
  <li>Generous PTO</li>
  <li>Travel on Breeze and other Airlines too!</li>
 </ul>
 <p><br>
   Breeze Airways provides equal employment opportunities to all Team Members and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.</p>
 <p><br>
   Breeze Airways will never request your Social Security Number, Driver’s License or Date of Birth on our job postings. Job Postings requesting any or all of this information should be regarded as a scam.</p>

#### Full job description

###### **About Vasion**

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

###### **About the role**

This role is remote or hybrid for candidates within commuting distance of one of our offices in St. George or Lehi, UT. Vasion is looking for a strategic, data-driven Head of Search & AI Visibility to own organic search, conversion rate optimization (CRO), AI/answer engine visibility, and digital analytics strategy across all of Marketing. Reporting to the Director, Digital Marketing, this is a key marketing leadership role responsible for two things at once: making sure Vasion is found, cited, and recommended everywhere its buyers are searching — from classic search engines to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini — and making sure that traffic actually converts once it arrives. The ideal candidate is a hands-on SEO, CRO, and analytics expert with real experience building AI/answer-engine visibility strategy, running a rigorous testing program, and a track record of managing outside agencies. This role manages Vasion's CRO/SEO agency partner (DataX Growth) and is expected to become the primary owner of Vasion's emerging AI-visibility and brand-sentiment monitoring tooling. Success looks like Product Marketing, PR, Growth, and Content coming to this role for direction on keywords, linking strategy, and AI-visibility health — and Marketing's conversion rates climbing because someone finally owns that number end-to-end.

###### **Responsibilities**

- Organic Search & AI Visibility Strategy
- - Own Vasion's SEO strategy across technical, content, and international SEO (AMER, APAC, EMEA)
  - Own Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategy, ensuring Vasion is cited and recommended across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, and emerging answer engines
  - Own brand and AI-visibility monitoring — tracking sentiment and share of voice across search, AI assistants, Reddit, and social — partnering with PR and Product Marketing to close visibility and sentiment gaps against competitors
  - Own competitive and keyword intelligence: rank tracking, share of voice, and keyword-gap analysis against competitors - Manage the agency relationships, including scope, deliverables, and performance accountability

- Conversion Rate Optimization
- - Own the CRO program end-to-end: hypothesis generation, A/B and multivariate test design, execution, analysis, and rollout
  - Build and continuously refine funnel maps for the website and lead-generation landing pages, using both quantitative and behavioral signals to find friction and prioritize tests
  - Partner with the web team on landing page design and implementation, translating test results into shipped improvements
  - Own website and digital-property personalization efforts, tailoring experiences to target audiences and segments

- Web & Digital Analytics
- - Own Vasion's web and digital analytics strategy across all of Marketing, including analytics architecture, tagging, and reporting infrastructure
  - Partner with the BI/Data team to integrate marketing analytics with our EDW and broader company data systems
  - Own cross-channel attribution and reporting, unifying paid, organic, and web performance into a single source of truth
  - Report on KPIs and revenue attainment/attribution across organic, CRO, and analytics-owned programs

- Cross-Functional Partnership
- - Educate and inform cross-functional partners on organic strategy, target keywords, and pages to link to
  - Partner closely with the web team to help steer website and digital property direction
  - Partner with Sales/RevOps on organic-sourced lead quality and pipeline feedback
  - Bring organic, analytics, and AI-visibility expertise to bear on Marketing's highest-priority initiatives, wherever they show up

###### **Qualifications**

- Requirements
- - 10+ years of experience in SEO, CRO, digital analytics, or growth marketing, including senior-level ownership of organic and conversion strategy
  - Deep hands-on expertise in technical SEO (schema, structured data, crawlability, site speed) and keyword strategy
  - Proven track record owning a CRO program end-to-end — hypothesis generation, A/B and multivariate testing, funnel analysis, and landing page optimization — with hands-on experience in platforms like VWO or Optimizely
  - Demonstrated experience building AEO/GEO strategies for visibility across AI assistants and answer engines
  - Strong command of GA4 and modern web/digital analytics platforms, with experience integrating marketing data into broader BI/data warehouse systems (e.g., Snowflake)
  - Experience with behavioral analytics tools (e.g., LogRocket, Hotjar) to diagnose friction and inform test prioritization
  - Experience managing outside agency relationships and holding agencies accountable to scope and performance
  - Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with a track record of influencing stakeholders across marketing, product, sales, and PR

- Preferred Qualifications
- - B2B SaaS or technology industry experience; e-commerce background a plus given its emphasis on CRO discipline
  - Experience with AI visibility/social listening platforms
  - Comfort directing or building AI-assisted workflows/agents to scale reporting and monitoring efficiently
  - Experience supporting international/multi-region SEO (localization, hreflang, regional keyword strategy)
  - GA4 certification
  - Highly analytical and self-directed, with comfort operating autonomously in a newly created role

- Key Competencies
- - An authority on how organic search, CRO, AI/answer engines, and analytics infrastructure drive pipeline and revenue — not just traffic
  - Obsessed with how search, conversion, and AI visibility actually work — from how crawlers parse a page, to what makes a visitor convert, to how large language models decide what to cite
  - A trusted advisor who partners fluidly across Product, PR, Sales, and Marketing to align organic strategy with company objectives
  - Strategic thinker who's equally hands-on: can read a GA4 property, audit schema markup, and manage an agency relationship personally
  - Action-owner who brings clarity to ambiguous, cross-functional problems and doesn't wait to be assigned
  - Clear communicator who translates technical SEO and analytics concepts for non-technical stakeholders across Product, PR, and Sales

###### **Benefits**

- Flexible work environment
- Vacation Bonus
- Flexible paid time off
- Paid parental leave
- Competitive pay
- A full suite of traditional benefits
- Training/Advancement opportunities
- 401k with company match and immediate vesting
- Financial wellness education
- Company-contributed HSA
- On-site perks include gym, pickleball, snacks & drinks, arcade, theater room, etc.

###### **Our Core Values**

Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become:

- **Disruptive Visionaries:** Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers.
- **Relationship Builders:** We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication.
- **Candor Seekers:** Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly.
- **Action Owners:** Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance.

Visit https://www.vasion.com to learn more about Vasion.

  <p>This role is remote or hybrid for candidates within commuting distance of one of our offices in St. George or Lehi, UT.      <ul>

#### Full job description

###### **About Vasion**

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

###### **About the role**

This role is remote or hybrid for candidates within commuting distance of one of our offices in St. George or Lehi, UT. Vasion is looking for a strategic, data-driven Head of Search & AI Visibility to own organic search, conversion rate optimization (CRO), AI/answer engine visibility, and digital analytics strategy across all of Marketing. Reporting to the Director, Digital Marketing, this is a key marketing leadership role responsible for two things at once: making sure Vasion is found, cited, and recommended everywhere its buyers are searching — from classic search engines to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini — and making sure that traffic actually converts once it arrives. The ideal candidate is a hands-on SEO, CRO, and analytics expert with real experience building AI/answer-engine visibility strategy, running a rigorous testing program, and a track record of managing outside agencies. This role manages Vasion's CRO/SEO agency partner (DataX Growth) and is expected to become the primary owner of Vasion's emerging AI-visibility and brand-sentiment monitoring tooling. Success looks like Product Marketing, PR, Growth, and Content coming to this role for direction on keywords, linking strategy, and AI-visibility health — and Marketing's conversion rates climbing because someone finally owns that number end-to-end.

###### **Responsibilities**

- Organic Search & AI Visibility Strategy
- - Own Vasion's SEO strategy across technical, content, and international SEO (AMER, APAC, EMEA)
  - Own Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategy, ensuring Vasion is cited and recommended across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, and emerging answer engines
  - Own brand and AI-visibility monitoring — tracking sentiment and share of voice across search, AI assistants, Reddit, and social — partnering with PR and Product Marketing to close visibility and sentiment gaps against competitors
  - Own competitive and keyword intelligence: rank tracking, share of voice, and keyword-gap analysis against competitors - Manage the agency relationships, including scope, deliverables, and performance accountability

- Conversion Rate Optimization
- - Own the CRO program end-to-end: hypothesis generation, A/B and multivariate test design, execution, analysis, and rollout
  - Build and continuously refine funnel maps for the website and lead-generation landing pages, using both quantitative and behavioral signals to find friction and prioritize tests
  - Partner with the web team on landing page design and implementation, translating test results into shipped improvements
  - Own website and digital-property personalization efforts, tailoring experiences to target audiences and segments

- Web & Digital Analytics
- - Own Vasion's web and digital analytics strategy across all of Marketing, including analytics architecture, tagging, and reporting infrastructure
  - Partner with the BI/Data team to integrate marketing analytics with our EDW and broader company data systems
  - Own cross-channel attribution and reporting, unifying paid, organic, and web performance into a single source of truth
  - Report on KPIs and revenue attainment/attribution across organic, CRO, and analytics-owned programs

- Cross-Functional Partnership
- - Educate and inform cross-functional partners on organic strategy, target keywords, and pages to link to
  - Partner closely with the web team to help steer website and digital property direction
  - Partner with Sales/RevOps on organic-sourced lead quality and pipeline feedback
  - Bring organic, analytics, and AI-visibility expertise to bear on Marketing's highest-priority initiatives, wherever they show up

###### **Qualifications**

- Requirements
- - 10+ years of experience in SEO, CRO, digital analytics, or growth marketing, including senior-level ownership of organic and conversion strategy
  - Deep hands-on expertise in technical SEO (schema, structured data, crawlability, site speed) and keyword strategy
  - Proven track record owning a CRO program end-to-end — hypothesis generation, A/B and multivariate testing, funnel analysis, and landing page optimization — with hands-on experience in platforms like VWO or Optimizely
  - Demonstrated experience building AEO/GEO strategies for visibility across AI assistants and answer engines
  - Strong command of GA4 and modern web/digital analytics platforms, with experience integrating marketing data into broader BI/data warehouse systems (e.g., Snowflake)
  - Experience with behavioral analytics tools (e.g., LogRocket, Hotjar) to diagnose friction and inform test prioritization
  - Experience managing outside agency relationships and holding agencies accountable to scope and performance
  - Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with a track record of influencing stakeholders across marketing, product, sales, and PR

- Preferred Qualifications
- - B2B SaaS or technology industry experience; e-commerce background a plus given its emphasis on CRO discipline
  - Experience with AI visibility/social listening platforms
  - Comfort directing or building AI-assisted workflows/agents to scale reporting and monitoring efficiently
  - Experience supporting international/multi-region SEO (localization, hreflang, regional keyword strategy)
  - GA4 certification
  - Highly analytical and self-directed, with comfort operating autonomously in a newly created role

- Key Competencies
- - An authority on how organic search, CRO, AI/answer engines, and analytics infrastructure drive pipeline and revenue — not just traffic
  - Obsessed with how search, conversion, and AI visibility actually work — from how crawlers parse a page, to what makes a visitor convert, to how large language models decide what to cite
  - A trusted advisor who partners fluidly across Product, PR, Sales, and Marketing to align organic strategy with company objectives
  - Strategic thinker who's equally hands-on: can read a GA4 property, audit schema markup, and manage an agency relationship personally
  - Action-owner who brings clarity to ambiguous, cross-functional problems and doesn't wait to be assigned
  - Clear communicator who translates technical SEO and analytics concepts for non-technical stakeholders across Product, PR, and Sales

###### **Our Core Values**

Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become:

- **Disruptive Visionaries:** Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers.
- **Relationship Builders:** We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication.
- **Candor Seekers:** Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly.
- **Action Owners:** Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance.

###### **About Vasion**

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

###### **About the role**

This role is remote or hybrid for candidates within commuting distance of one of our offices in St. George or Lehi, UT. Vasion is looking for a strategic, data-driven Head of Search & AI Visibility to own organic search, conversion rate optimization (CRO), AI/answer engine visibility, and digital analytics strategy across all of Marketing. Reporting to the Director, Digital Marketing, this is a key marketing leadership role responsible for two things at once: making sure Vasion is found, cited, and recommended everywhere its buyers are searching — from classic search engines to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini — and making sure that traffic actually converts once it arrives. The ideal candidate is a hands-on SEO, CRO, and analytics expert with real experience building AI/answer-engine visibility strategy, running a rigorous testing program, and a track record of managing outside agencies. This role manages Vasion's CRO/SEO agency partner (DataX Growth) and is expected to become the primary owner of Vasion's emerging AI-visibility and brand-sentiment monitoring tooling. Success looks like Product Marketing, PR, Growth, and Content coming to this role for direction on keywords, linking strategy, and AI-visibility health — and Marketing's conversion rates climbing because someone finally owns that number end-to-end.

###### **Responsibilities**

- Organic Search & AI Visibility Strategy
- - Own Vasion's SEO strategy across technical, content, and international SEO (AMER, APAC, EMEA)
  - Own Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategy, ensuring Vasion is cited and recommended across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, and emerging answer engines
  - Own brand and AI-visibility monitoring — tracking sentiment and share of voice across search, AI assistants, Reddit, and social — partnering with PR and Product Marketing to close visibility and sentiment gaps against competitors
  - Own competitive and keyword intelligence: rank tracking, share of voice, and keyword-gap analysis against competitors - Manage the agency relationships, including scope, deliverables, and performance accountability

- Conversion Rate Optimization
- - Own the CRO program end-to-end: hypothesis generation, A/B and multivariate test design, execution, analysis, and rollout
  - Build and continuously refine funnel maps for the website and lead-generation landing pages, using both quantitative and behavioral signals to find friction and prioritize tests
  - Partner with the web team on landing page design and implementation, translating test results into shipped improvements
  - Own website and digital-property personalization efforts, tailoring experiences to target audiences and segments

- Web & Digital Analytics
- - Own Vasion's web and digital analytics strategy across all of Marketing, including analytics architecture, tagging, and reporting infrastructure
  - Partner with the BI/Data team to integrate marketing analytics with our EDW and broader company data systems
  - Own cross-channel attribution and reporting, unifying paid, organic, and web performance into a single source of truth
  - Report on KPIs and revenue attainment/attribution across organic, CRO, and analytics-owned programs

- Cross-Functional Partnership
- - Educate and inform cross-functional partners on organic strategy, target keywords, and pages to link to
  - Partner closely with the web team to help steer website and digital property direction
  - Partner with Sales/RevOps on organic-sourced lead quality and pipeline feedback
  - Bring organic, analytics, and AI-visibility expertise to bear on Marketing's highest-priority initiatives, wherever they show up

###### **Qualifications**

- Requirements
- - 10+ years of experience in SEO, CRO, digital analytics, or growth marketing, including senior-level ownership of organic and conversion strategy
  - Deep hands-on expertise in technical SEO (schema, structured data, crawlability, site speed) and keyword strategy
  - Proven track record owning a CRO program end-to-end — hypothesis generation, A/B and multivariate testing, funnel analysis, and landing page optimization — with hands-on experience in platforms like VWO or Optimizely
  - Demonstrated experience building AEO/GEO strategies for visibility across AI assistants and answer engines
  - Strong command of GA4 and modern web/digital analytics platforms, with experience integrating marketing data into broader BI/data warehouse systems (e.g., Snowflake)
  - Experience with behavioral analytics tools (e.g., LogRocket, Hotjar) to diagnose friction and inform test prioritization
  - Experience managing outside agency relationships and holding agencies accountable to scope and performance
  - Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with a track record of influencing stakeholders across marketing, product, sales, and PR

- Preferred Qualifications
- - B2B SaaS or technology industry experience; e-commerce background a plus given its emphasis on CRO discipline
  - Experience with AI visibility/social listening platforms
  - Comfort directing or building AI-assisted workflows/agents to scale reporting and monitoring efficiently
  - Experience supporting international/multi-region SEO (localization, hreflang, regional keyword strategy)
  - GA4 certification
  - Highly analytical and self-directed, with comfort operating autonomously in a newly created role

- Key Competencies
- - An authority on how organic search, CRO, AI/answer engines, and analytics infrastructure drive pipeline and revenue — not just traffic
  - Obsessed with how search, conversion, and AI visibility actually work — from how crawlers parse a page, to what makes a visitor convert, to how large language models decide what to cite
  - A trusted advisor who partners fluidly across Product, PR, Sales, and Marketing to align organic strategy with company objectives
  - Strategic thinker who's equally hands-on: can read a GA4 property, audit schema markup, and manage an agency relationship personally
  - Action-owner who brings clarity to ambiguous, cross-functional problems and doesn't wait to be assigned
  - Clear communicator who translates technical SEO and analytics concepts for non-technical stakeholders across Product, PR, and Sales

###### **Benefits**

- Flexible work environment
- Vacation Bonus
- Flexible paid time off
- Paid parental leave
- Competitive pay
- A full suite of traditional benefits
- Training/Advancement opportunities
- 401k with company match and immediate vesting
- Financial wellness education
- Company-contributed HSA
- On-site perks include gym, pickleball, snacks & drinks, arcade, theater room, etc.

###### **Our Core Values**

Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become:

- **Disruptive Visionaries:** Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers.
- **Relationship Builders:** We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication.
- **Candor Seekers:** Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly.
- **Action Owners:** Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance.

Visit https://www.vasion.com to learn more about Vasion.

###### **Additional Information**

Vasion is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation and other legally protected characteristics.

  <h6><b>About Vasion</b></h6>
  <p>For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration.   <h6><b><br>
     About the role</b></h6>
  <p>This role is remote or hybrid for candidates within commuting distance of one of our offices in St. George or Lehi, UT. Vasion is looking for a strategic, data-driven Head of Search & AI Visibility to own organic search, conversion rate optimization (CRO), AI/answer engine visibility, and digital analytics strategy across all of Marketing. Reporting to the Director, Digital Marketing, this is a key marketing leadership role responsible for two things at once: making sure Vasion is found, cited, and recommended everywhere its buyers are searching — from classic search engines to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini — and making sure that traffic actually converts once it arrives. The ideal candidate is a hands-on SEO, CRO, and analytics expert with real experience building AI/answer-engine visibility strategy, running a rigorous testing program, and a track record of managing outside agencies. This role manages Vasion's CRO/SEO agency partner (DataX Growth) and is expected to become the primary owner of Vasion's emerging AI-visibility and brand-sentiment monitoring tooling. Success looks like Product Marketing, PR, Growth, and Content coming to this role for direction on keywords, linking strategy, and AI-visibility health — and Marketing's conversion rates climbing because someone finally owns that number end-to-end.</p>

Company Summary:

We are a health and wellness center focused on functional medicine and disorders of the endocrine system. Our providers offer personalized care plans to address the symptoms of thyroid and autoimmunity. We offer in-person and remote appointments.

Benefits:

We offer holiday pay and paid time off.

Job Summary:

We are hiring a Director of Marketing to lead and execute the marketing strategy for our eight (and growing) Wellness Centers. This individual will be responsible for building and elevating the brand, leading digital marketing efforts, such as; Meta platforms, TV, Streaming, and Podcasts, etc. as well as copywriting, copyediting, overseeing website content, and ensuring that our messaging aligns with our patient care model.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and creative marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can balance high-level branding with hands-on execution. You’ll work closely with the owner and office managers to ensure marketing initiatives support broader business goals — from brand awareness and clinic bookings to patient education and partner engagement.

This role requires a detail oriented and creative thinker with a deep understanding of market trends, digital marketing, and analytics.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and lead the overall marketing strategy for all RedRiver Health and Wellness Center locations.
  • Build a strong, differentiated brand that reflects our values, services, and target audience
  • Ensure consistency in messaging across all marketing platforms
  • Oversee our current website so it clearly communicates our services and value of care
  • Oversee SEO/SEM, Google Ads, and paid social advertising across Meta platforms, TV, Streaming services, and TikTok to drive traffic, brand awareness, and patient conversion
  • Schedule and oversee podcast events
  • Develop marketing collateral, landing pages, and email campaigns as needed
  • Build and execute a social media strategy tailored to an executive, health-conscious audience
  • Partner with leadership and physicians to translate complex services into clear, engaging content
  • Manage copywriting and copyediting and creative direction for campaigns, newsletters, and blog posts
  • Collaborate with management teams to align marketing with business priorities
  • Identify and develop external partnerships (PR, brand ambassadors, local organizations) to expand reach
  • Support events, campaigns, or initiatives that position the center as a destination for help with the symptoms of autoimmune and thyroid conditions
  • Create detailed reports
  • Stay in direct contact with corporate management and office management to track the effectiveness of marketing, spending, and conversion rates for each location
  • Analyze campaign performance using analytics tools to measure effectiveness and inform future strategies.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, preferably in healthcare and/or wellness
  • Experience leading brand development and building marketing programs from the ground up
  • Strong digital marketing skills, including website strategy, paid ads, and social content
  • Excellent writing, communication, and project management skills
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally and align marketing with broader business goals
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment
  • Detail oriented
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including excel, for detailed reports and analysis
  • Utilize Adobe Creative Suite for designing marketing collateral that resonates with target audiences.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in digital marketing.
  • Strong budgeting skills to manage marketing expenditure effectively.
  • Proficiency in SEO techniques to enhance online visibility.
  • In-depth knowledge of market analysis and consumer behavior.
  • Familiarity with HTML for website management and content updates.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Experience in e-commerce platforms to optimize online sales performance.
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics for tracking website performance and campaign success.

1142 West 2320 South Ste A-1 Salt Lake City, Utah 84119

Senior Specialist Paid Search (SEM)


The Opportunity

Paid search will be one of the largest and most important channels in this engine, and this is the seat that runs it. You will own day to day management of high-volume, performance/ROI focused Google Ads and Microsoft Ads programs with real profitability targets, rebuild account structures for a modern, AI driven platform era, and help vet and onboard the advertising and MarTech vendors that power the channel. Your campaigns feed a National Inside Sales team, so success is measured by tracking KPIs such as qualified lead volume, connected leads, sold subscriptions, and customer acquisition costs (CAC). This is a hands-on role with a clear growth path as the channel and the team scale.


What You Will Own

  • Day to day management of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads portfolios at high volume, against profitability, CPL, and CAC targets
  • Account architecture: rebuilding and restructuring campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and assets for how the platforms actually work today and to capture demand at scale.
  • Bidding strategy: smart bidding fueled by offline conversion values, so the algorithms optimize toward sold subscriptions rather than simply raw lead volume. This will be a work in progress.
  • The platform frontier: hands on use of the newest Google and Microsoft capabilities, including Performance Max, AI powered search campaigns, Demand Gen, asset and audience signal strategy, and coordination with Local Services Ads and more.
  • Structured testing: bid strategy experiments, incrementality reads, ad copy and landing page tests, and clean documentation of what wins.
  • Vendor evaluation: helping vet, pilot, and onboard new advertising and MarTech vendors in the paid search space, with clear recommendations to the Director.
  • Budget pacing and forecasting for the search channel, with weekly reporting on spend, CPL, CAC, and ROAS.
  • Conversion tracking integrity in partnership with the analytics team, including call tracking and offline conversion feeds


What You Will Bring

Required

  • 4+ years of hands-on paid search experience building and managing profitable, high-volume programs, including meaningful annual budgets.
  • Experience creating, managing, and optimizing local focused digital marketing campaigns.
  • Deep, current knowledge of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, including the newest campaign types, bidding features, and AI powered capabilities in both platforms.
  • Experience vetting, piloting, and onboarding advertising or MarTech vendors.
  • Strong analytical skills: exceptionally skilled in Microsoft Excel, comfortable in reporting tools, and rigorous about test design.
  • A builder mentality: comfortable rebuilding accounts and processes from a basic state to a sophisticated one.

Preferred

  • Experience driving leads for an inside sales or call-based conversion environment, including call tracking platforms.
  • Local Services Ads management experience.
  • Home services and/or local services category experience.
  • Current Google Ads certifications (not required)


Who Thrives Here

Straight talk about what this is. We are building a lead generation and online customer acquisition engine from the ground up, in an industry that has never seen one built this well. The pace will be fast, team culture will be one of winning and collaboration, and the celebrations will be exciting as we grow and hit our targets. That is exactly what makes it fun.

  • You build, you do not maintain. Your fingerprints will be on something that did not exist before you showed up.
  • Real budget, real backing. Direct line to a fully committed CMO and executive team.
  • Outcomes over activity. You will be measured on what you actually produce, and when it works, everyone will know exactly who built it.
  • It will ask a lot of you. This is not a coasting seat. The people who lean all the way in will look back on this as the most career defining work they have done.

If you want to babysit an account that someone else already optimized, this is not the seat. If you want to build one from the ground up and scale it, this is the place for you!


Why Work for EcoShield Pest Solutions?

The Shield Co. Management / EcoShield Pest Solutions is one of the fastest-growing pest control companies in the country! Our mission is to create the world’s happiest family, and our purpose is to spread happiness. We do this by delivering exceptional experiences to our customers, employees, partners, and communities—treating everyone like family.

EcoShield Pest Solutions is proud to offer competitive pay and full benefits!

  • Competitive compensation package, with base salary commensurate with experience.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) plan with employer matching.
  • Paid sick and vacation time along with 10 company-paid holidays.
  • In-office work model with the expectation of being in office 5 days a week.


Physical Demands and Working Requirements

The physical demands and working conditions outlined here are typical requirements for an employee to effectively carry out the essential duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to assist individuals with disabilities in performing these essential functions.

  • Requires prolonged periods of sitting at a desk or workstation
  • Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing and using a computer mouse
  • Occasionally lift and carry office materials or supplies up to 25 pounds
  • Requires clear vision for reading documents, computer screens, and other office materials
  • Work is inside a climate-controlled office with quiet to moderate noise level

The above statements are meant to outline the general nature and scope of work performed by employees in this role. They should not be interpreted as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required for this position.


EcoShield is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion. We make employment decisions based on merit and business needs, without discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.


Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA): The Shield Co. Management, LLC is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities during both the hiring process and throughout employment, in accordance with applicable laws.

#### Full job description

**Healthcare’s helping hand.**

CHG shook things up in 1979 by inventing the locum tenens staffing model. We connect doctors with patients who need their care. As the largest physician staffing firm in America, our providers treat millions of patients each year.

Our industry is growing and demand is high. This means you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in your career. Keeping healthcare healthy can be as fun as it is rewarding

This Brand Manager in our CHG Healthcare Corporate Marketing Division will bring brand strategy to life through creative, well-executed campaigns. The ideal candidate is a hands-on marketer who thrives in execution, brings fresh creative and innovative thinking to every campaign, and builds strong relationships with sales leaders and representatives to keep marketing connected to what's happening in the field. They will manage the day-to-day delivery of brand campaigns across channels, from creative development through launch, and track results to continuously sharpen what's working. This full-time position is based out of Midvale, Utah and will report to the Sr. Brand Director.

**Responsibilities**

- Manage day-to-day execution of the marketing plan, translating strategy set by senior leadership into specific campaigns and tactics.

- Collaborate to build annual strategic marketing plans and manage annual budgets.
- Own brand positioning across all campaigns, ensuring every execution amplifies the brand.
- Apply a strong understanding of audience segments, their needs, and what drives them.
- Bring creative, innovative thinking to campaign concepts, offers, and content that capture attention and differentiates the brand.
- Write clear, inspirational creative briefs that give creative a strong foundation to produce great work.
- Work with channel partners to execute integrated campaigns across TV, audio, sponsorships and partnerships, PR, social, display, content, conferences, events, and website.
- Support the content strategy throughout the sales funnel (from awareness to conversion) with informative/educational resources and unique storytelling.
- Track and report results of campaigns and marketing efforts, including reach, engagement, and conversion, and use the data to sharpen future execution.
- Support brand health tracking, including awareness, consideration, and sentiment, by pulling and synthesizing data for leadership.
- Partner with sales leaders and representatives to understand day-to-day needs and turn them into marketing support.
- Partner with other marketing team members across growth, media, content, PR, website, and social to keep messaging and timing aligned.
- Act as a brand steward, keeping standards consistent both externally and across the organization.
- Monitor competitors and industry trends, bringing fresh ideas and best practices back to the team.
- Provide guidance and support to other team members as needed.

**Qualifications**

- Creative and resourceful, with a knack for generating fresh campaign ideas and new ways to tell the brand story
- Strategic thinking with strong business acumen and ability to align marketing initiatives with company objectives
- Comfortable building relationships across the organization
- High capacity for fast-paced work and highly self-driven
- Deals well with ambiguity and has worked in a complex industry or multi-brand organizations
- Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines
- Strong verbal and written communicator and ability to build trusting relationships with senior leadership
- Collaborative team player

- Adaptable and quick to pivot when priorities or results change
- Data-informed and adjusts based on learnings; experience with brand health tracking, native campaign reporting, and Adobe Analytics

**Education & Experience**

- Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or business
- Seven or more years of marketing experience, ideally in brand or digital marketing

**Preferred**

- Healthcare or staffing experience
- Advanced degree in marketing, business, or related field

#### Full job description

**Healthcare’s helping hand.**

CHG shook things up in 1979 by inventing the locum tenens staffing model. We connect doctors with patients who need their care. As the largest physician staffing firm in America, our providers treat millions of patients each year.

Our industry is growing and demand is high. This means you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in your career. Keeping healthcare healthy can be as fun as it is rewarding

This Brand Manager in our CHG Healthcare Corporate Marketing Division will bring brand strategy to life through creative, well-executed campaigns. The ideal candidate is a hands-on marketer who thrives in execution, brings fresh creative and innovative thinking to every campaign, and builds strong relationships with sales leaders and representatives to keep marketing connected to what's happening in the field. They will manage the day-to-day delivery of brand campaigns across channels, from creative development through launch, and track results to continuously sharpen what's working. This full-time position is based out of Midvale, Utah and will report to the Sr. Brand Director.

**Responsibilities**

- Manage day-to-day execution of the marketing plan, translating strategy set by senior leadership into specific campaigns and tactics.

- Collaborate to build annual strategic marketing plans and manage annual budgets.
- Own brand positioning across all campaigns, ensuring every execution amplifies the brand.
- Apply a strong understanding of audience segments, their needs, and what drives them.
- Bring creative, innovative thinking to campaign concepts, offers, and content that capture attention and differentiates the brand.
- Write clear, inspirational creative briefs that give creative a strong foundation to produce great work.
- Work with channel partners to execute integrated campaigns across TV, audio, sponsorships and partnerships, PR, social, display, content, conferences, events, and website.
- Support the content strategy throughout the sales funnel (from awareness to conversion) with informative/educational resources and unique storytelling.
- Track and report results of campaigns and marketing efforts, including reach, engagement, and conversion, and use the data to sharpen future execution.
- Support brand health tracking, including awareness, consideration, and sentiment, by pulling and synthesizing data for leadership.
- Partner with sales leaders and representatives to understand day-to-day needs and turn them into marketing support.
- Partner with other marketing team members across growth, media, content, PR, website, and social to keep messaging and timing aligned.
- Act as a brand steward, keeping standards consistent both externally and across the organization.
- Monitor competitors and industry trends, bringing fresh ideas and best practices back to the team.
- Provide guidance and support to other team members as needed.

**Qualifications**

- Creative and resourceful, with a knack for generating fresh campaign ideas and new ways to tell the brand story
- Strategic thinking with strong business acumen and ability to align marketing initiatives with company objectives
- Comfortable building relationships across the organization
- High capacity for fast-paced work and highly self-driven
- Deals well with ambiguity and has worked in a complex industry or multi-brand organizations
- Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines
- Strong verbal and written communicator and ability to build trusting relationships with senior leadership
- Collaborative team player

- Adaptable and quick to pivot when priorities or results change
- Data-informed and adjusts based on learnings; experience with brand health tracking, native campaign reporting, and Adobe Analytics

**Education & Experience**

- Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or business
- Seven or more years of marketing experience, ideally in brand or digital marketing

**Preferred**

- Healthcare or staffing experience
- Advanced degree in marketing, business, or related field

#### Full job description

**Healthcare’s helping hand.**

CHG shook things up in 1979 by inventing the locum tenens staffing model. We connect doctors with patients who need their care. As the largest physician staffing firm in America, our providers treat millions of patients each year.

Our industry is growing and demand is high. This means you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in your career. Keeping healthcare healthy can be as fun as it is rewarding

This Brand Manager in our CHG Healthcare Corporate Marketing Division will bring brand strategy to life through creative, well-executed campaigns. The ideal candidate is a hands-on marketer who thrives in execution, brings fresh creative and innovative thinking to every campaign, and builds strong relationships with sales leaders and representatives to keep marketing connected to what's happening in the field. They will manage the day-to-day delivery of brand campaigns across channels, from creative development through launch, and track results to continuously sharpen what's working. This full-time position is based out of Midvale, Utah and will report to the Sr. Brand Director.

**Responsibilities**

- Manage day-to-day execution of the marketing plan, translating strategy set by senior leadership into specific campaigns and tactics.

- Collaborate to build annual strategic marketing plans and manage annual budgets.
- Own brand positioning across all campaigns, ensuring every execution amplifies the brand.
- Apply a strong understanding of audience segments, their needs, and what drives them.
- Bring creative, innovative thinking to campaign concepts, offers, and content that capture attention and differentiates the brand.
- Write clear, inspirational creative briefs that give creative a strong foundation to produce great work.
- Work with channel partners to execute integrated campaigns across TV, audio, sponsorships and partnerships, PR, social, display, content, conferences, events, and website.
- Support the content strategy throughout the sales funnel (from awareness to conversion) with informative/educational resources and unique storytelling.
- Track and report results of campaigns and marketing efforts, including reach, engagement, and conversion, and use the data to sharpen future execution.
- Support brand health tracking, including awareness, consideration, and sentiment, by pulling and synthesizing data for leadership.
- Partner with sales leaders and representatives to understand day-to-day needs and turn them into marketing support.
- Partner with other marketing team members across growth, media, content, PR, website, and social to keep messaging and timing aligned.
- Act as a brand steward, keeping standards consistent both externally and across the organization.
- Monitor competitors and industry trends, bringing fresh ideas and best practices back to the team.
- Provide guidance and support to other team members as needed.

**Qualifications**

- Creative and resourceful, with a knack for generating fresh campaign ideas and new ways to tell the brand story
- Strategic thinking with strong business acumen and ability to align marketing initiatives with company objectives
- Comfortable building relationships across the organization
- High capacity for fast-paced work and highly self-driven
- Deals well with ambiguity and has worked in a complex industry or multi-brand organizations
- Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines
- Strong verbal and written communicator and ability to build trusting relationships with senior leadership
- Collaborative team player

- Adaptable and quick to pivot when priorities or results change
- Data-informed and adjusts based on learnings; experience with brand health tracking, native campaign reporting, and Adobe Analytics

**Education & Experience**

- Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or business
- Seven or more years of marketing experience, ideally in brand or digital marketing

**Preferred**

- Healthcare or staffing experience
- Advanced degree in marketing, business, or related field

 <p><b>Healthcare’s helping hand.</b><br><br>
   CHG shook things up in 1979 by inventing the locum tenens staffing model. We connect doctors with patients who need their care. As the largest physician staffing firm in America, our providers treat millions of patients each year.<br><br>
   Our industry is growing and demand is high. This means you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in your career. Keeping healthcare healthy can be as fun as it is rewarding</p>
 <p>This Brand Manager in our CHG Healthcare Corporate Marketing Division will bring brand strategy to life through creative, well-executed campaigns. The ideal candidate is a hands-on marketer who thrives in execution, brings fresh creative and innovative thinking to every campaign, and builds strong relationships with sales leaders and representatives to keep marketing connected to what's happening in the field. They will manage the day-to-day delivery of brand campaigns across channels, from creative development through launch, and track results to continuously sharpen what's working. This full-time position is based out of Midvale, Utah and will report to the Sr. Brand Director.</p>
 <p><b><br>
    Responsibilities</b></p>
 <ul>
  <li>Manage day-to-day execution of the marketing plan, translating strategy set by senior leadership into specific campaigns and tactics.</li>
 </ul>
 <ul>
  <li>Collaborate to build annual strategic marketing plans and manage annual budgets.</li>
  <li>Own brand positioning across all campaigns, ensuring every execution amplifies the brand.</li>
  <li>Apply a strong understanding of audience segments, their needs, and what drives them.</li>
  <li>Bring creative, innovative thinking to campaign concepts, offers, and content that capture attention and differentiates the brand.</li>
  <li>Write clear, inspirational creative briefs that give creative a strong foundation to produce great work.</li>
  <li>Work with channel partners to execute integrated campaigns across TV, audio, sponsorships and partnerships, PR, social, display, content, conferences, events, and website.</li>
  <li>Support the content strategy throughout the sales funnel (from awareness to conversion) with informative/educational resources and unique storytelling.</li>
  <li>Track and report results of campaigns and marketing efforts, including reach, engagement, and conversion, and use the data to sharpen future execution.</li>
  <li>Support brand health tracking, including awareness, consideration, and sentiment, by pulling and synthesizing data for leadership.</li>
  <li>Partner with sales leaders and representatives to understand day-to-day needs and turn them into marketing support.</li>
  <li>Partner with other marketing team members across growth, media, content, PR, website, and social to keep messaging and timing aligned.</li>
  <li>Act as a brand steward, keeping standards consistent both externally and across the organization.</li>
  <li>Monitor competitors and industry trends, bringing fresh ideas and best practices back to the team.</li>
  <li>Provide guidance and support to other team members as needed.</li>
 </ul>
 <p><b><br>
    Qualifications</b></p>
 <ul>
  <li>Creative and resourceful, with a knack for generating fresh campaign ideas and new ways to tell the brand story</li>
  <li>Strategic thinking with strong business acumen and ability to align marketing initiatives with company objectives</li>
  <li>Comfortable building relationships across the organization</li>
  <li>High capacity for fast-paced work and highly self-driven</li>
  <li>Deals well with ambiguity and has worked in a complex industry or multi-brand organizations</li>
  <li>Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines</li>
  <li>Strong verbal and written communicator and ability to build trusting relationships with senior leadership</li>
  <li>Collaborative team player</li>
 </ul>
 <ul>
  <li>Adaptable and quick to pivot when priorities or results change</li>
  <li>Data-informed and adjusts based on learnings; experience with brand health tracking, native campaign reporting, and Adobe Analytics</li>
 </ul>
 <p><b><br>
    Education & Experience</b></p>
 <ul>
  <li>Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or business</li>
  <li>Seven or more years of marketing experience, ideally in brand or digital marketing</li>
 </ul>
 <p><b><br>
    Preferred</b></p>
 <ul>
  <li>Healthcare or staffing experience</li>
  <li>Advanced degree in marketing, business, or related field</li>
 </ul>
 <p><i><br>
    We believe in fair compensation for all of our people, which is why our pay structure takes into account the cost of labor across U.S. geographic markets. For this position, we offer a pay range of $92,900 - $179,700 annually, with pay varying depending on work location and job-related factors such as knowledge, position level and experience. During the hiring process, your recruiter can provide more information about the specific salary range for the job location.</i></p>
 <p><i><br>
    CHG Healthcare offers starting salaries for sales positions in the form of total target compensation (TTC = base + commission + bonus), which includes base pay, commission, and bonuses. Sales positions receive short-term incentives through commission plans and bonuses. On the other hand, non-sales positions have starting salaries that consist of a base salary and short-term incentives through various bonus plans, which are paid out monthly, quarterly, or annually.</i></p>
