#### Full job description

Description:


PRIME Corporate Services is seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager to own paid customer acquisition across every channel we buy.

Reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing, this person is accountable for the performance of our paid media program: Google Search, Meta, and the emerging channels we have not built yet. You will own the accounts day to day, run the testing roadmap, own the conversion tracking that tells us whether any of it worked, and decide where the next dollar should go.

Accountability in this role does not stop at the booked consultation. Working closely with the Sales team, you are also responsible for the quality of the traffic we buy and the orders it ultimately produces. Volume that does not convert is not a win here, and a channel that looks efficient on cost per lead but poor on closed business is a problem you are expected to find and fix.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will build the campaigns, write the ad copy, brief Design on creative, implement the tracking with Engineering support, and read the results yourself.

Analytical rigor is central to the role. A large share of this job is deciding what a number actually means: whether a CPA movement is signal or noise, whether a test has run long enough to read, whether a platform's reported conversions reflect real revenue. The best people in this seat are comfortable being the one who says the data does not support that conclusion yet, and equally comfortable acting decisively once it does.

A significant part of this role is expansion. Paid channels are proliferating faster than most teams can evaluate them, and we want someone who can design a real test for a new platform, run it with discipline, and tell us honestly whether to scale it or kill it. That includes AI-native inventory like ChatGPT Ads, where the targeting and optimization levers are limited and results depend far more on offer clarity and clean measurement than on platform sophistication.

You will own how and where our paid budget gets deployed. Material shifts to the total go through an approval step, but the channel mix, the strategy behind it, and the calls about what we test and where we scale are yours to drive.

## **Who we are**

Remember when every step of launching your dream felt like a mountain? Debt loomed, the tax code was a cryptic puzzle, and building a rock-solid foundation seemed impossible. PRIME Corporate Services was forged from that very struggle - by entrepreneurs who knew there had to be a better way.

We are not just a faceless firm; we are a co-pilot for founders, operators, and business builders navigating the chaos of growth. We help cut through red tape, simplify complex systems, and help entrepreneurs structure their business for long-term financial freedom.

From entity structuring to tax strategy to business credit and funding, we don't just protect businesses - we help to scale them. Our team partners directly with high-growth entrepreneurs and affiliate partners to drive measurable outcomes; more leads, more revenue, and stronger businesses.

We deliver expert guidance and exceptional service at every stage of the business journey.

**Our Mission:** We aim to serve, advise, and support entrepreneurs every day.

## **Why You'll Love Working Here**

- **Impact at scale:** Your work will shape the experience of thousands of entrepreneurs working with PRIME.
- **Autonomy + Accountability:** You'll be trusted to lead, experiment, and deliver results — no micromanagement, just momentum.
- **Collaborative Culture:** You'll work alongside creative thinkers, engineers, and business leaders who care deeply about customer success and innovation.
- **Modernization Mission:** You'll play a key role in bringing advanced tech, analytics, and discipline to a growing organization — setting the foundation for the next generation of PRIME's digital ecosystem.

## **Benefits & Perks**

- Competitive Compensation + performance based bonuses
- Comprehensive Health Coverage - Medical, dental, and vision
- Paid Time Off - Generous PTO, sick days, and paid holidays
- 401k with Company match (we match up to 4%)
- Parental Leave - Paid leave for new parents
- Impact-Driven Culture - Small team, big mission
- Gym Pass - Company sponsored access to local gyms
- Free soda and snacks
- Discounts on Cellular/Wireless bills
- Robust Employee Resource Program with tele-health and more

Requirements:


**Channel Management**

- Own day-to-day management of Google Search, Performance Max, and Demand Gen campaigns, plus Meta campaigns across acquisition and retargeting
- Own account architecture: campaign hierarchy, naming conventions, and account isolation across the Google Ads MCC and parallel Microsoft Advertising structure
- Own keyword strategy, match type mix, search term mining, and negative keyword management
- Own audience strategy, including Customer Match list segmentation, lookalike seeding, retargeting lookback windows, and exclusion logic that keeps existing customers out of prospecting campaigns
- Manage bid strategies and budget pacing, including navigating learning phase thresholds rather than resetting them accidentally
- Monitor and act on auction diagnostics, impression share loss, creative fatigue, and frequency

**Testing and Analysis**

- Maintain an always-on testing roadmap across audiences, creative, ad copy, offers, bid strategies, and landing pages
- Size tests so results are readable, evaluate them for statistical significance, and resist the pull to call a winner early
- Maintain a documented testing log in which every test has a stated hypothesis, a primary metric, a sample size target, and a recorded outcome, so learnings compound instead of being relearned every quarter
- Build your own analysis rather than waiting on a report from someone else, including pulling and reconciling data across ad platforms, GA4, and Salesforce
- Diagnose performance changes accurately, distinguishing platform volatility and seasonality from a real shift in the business
- Partner closely with the Sales team on lead quality and close rates, following performance past the click and past the booked consultation through to orders placed, and adjust targeting, offers, and creative based on what actually converts rather than what generates the most volume

**New Channel Development**

- Identify and evaluate new paid channels and placements against our ICP and unit economics
- Design channel tests with defined budgets, success criteria, and kill criteria established before any spend goes live
- Launch and learn in emerging inventory, including AI-native placements, where optimization levers are minimal and first-party data plus offer clarity carry the campaign
- Make evidence-based scale or kill recommendations and defend them to leadership

**Creative and Copy**

- Write ad copy across search, social, and emerging placements
- Brief Design on static and video concepts and maintain a creative testing pipeline that does not run dry
- Partner with Legal on claims review, which matters here: we sell tax strategy, business credit, and estate planning, and advertising claims in those categories carry real regulatory exposure

**Measurement**

- Own conversion tracking end to end with Engineering support, including Google Tag Manager, platform pixels and conversion APIs, and GA4 configuration
- Own offline conversion value passing from Salesforce back into the ad platforms so bidding algorithms optimize toward qualified pipeline and revenue rather than form fills
- Define and enforce UTM taxonomy across every campaign and channel
- Report on CPL, CPA, and CAC against target ceilings, and flag when a channel is drifting past them
- Understand the limits of platform-reported attribution, and know when a question needs multi-touch attribution, an incrementality holdout, or a statistical inference approach instead
- Build toward the data foundation required for media mix modeling as spend and channel count grow

**Budget and Planning**

- Own channel allocation strategy and drive the budget decisions across the paid portfolio, with forecasts and scenarios behind each call and approval required for material changes to the total
- Manage in-month pacing and own flight extension and reallocation decisions
- Present performance, learnings, and recommendations to marketing and executive leadership on a regular cadence

## **Accountabilities**

The Senior Paid Media Manager is accountable for:

- Cost per acquisition against target ceilings and the volume of qualified consultations generated by paid media
- Alongside the Sales team, the quality of paid traffic and the orders those consultations convert into
- Overall efficiency of paid spend, including the identification and elimination of waste
- Channel mix decisions and the quality of the reasoning behind them
- Accuracy and completeness of conversion tracking, and the integrity of the data flowing back into every ad platform
- Testing velocity, the analytical rigor applied to results, and the quality of documented learnings produced
- Account hygiene and documentation, such that any competent marketer could pick up the accounts and understand them
- Rigor of new channel evaluation, including success and kill criteria defined before spend begins
- Accurate, timely, and honest performance reporting, including when results are bad

## **Minimum Education Requirements**

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Analytics, Statistics, or related field required
- Equivalent demonstrated experience considered in lieu of degree

## **Minimum Experience Requirements**

- 5 to 8 years managing paid media budgets, in-house or agency side
- Deep hands-on ownership of Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, including building campaigns and account structures from scratch rather than optimizing inside someone else's build
- Demonstrated experience implementing conversion tracking, including Google Tag Manager, platform conversion APIs, and GA4
- Experience passing offline conversion data from a CRM back into ad platforms; Salesforce preferred
- Track record of launching at least one paid channel from zero, including the measurement setup and the decision to scale or shut it down
- Strong ad copywriting ability; you can write the test, not just brief it
- Demonstrated experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, including sizing for statistical significance
- Strong quantitative skills and advanced spreadsheet analysis, with genuine comfort working across large, messy, and conflicting performance datasets
- Working knowledge of SQL, Looker Studio, or a comparable BI tool preferred
- Experience marketing to small business owners, solopreneurs, or 1099 earners preferred
- Experience in a regulated category such as financial services, tax, legal, insurance, or lending preferred

- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
- Familiarity with Salesforce reporting and Zapier or comparable automation tooling

## **Physical Requirements**

The work environment characteristics and associated physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk, working on a computer, and taking phone calls
- Must be able to lift 25 pounds periodically
- Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization's facilities
- Travel (less than 10% annually) may be required for sales support, training, and/or professional development

Description:


PRIME Corporate Services is seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager to own paid customer acquisition across every channel we buy.

Reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing, this person is accountable for the performance of our paid media program: Google Search, Meta, and the emerging channels we have not built yet. You will own the accounts day to day, run the testing roadmap, own the conversion tracking that tells us whether any of it worked, and decide where the next dollar should go.

Accountability in this role does not stop at the booked consultation. Working closely with the Sales team, you are also responsible for the quality of the traffic we buy and the orders it ultimately produces. Volume that does not convert is not a win here, and a channel that looks efficient on cost per lead but poor on closed business is a problem you are expected to find and fix.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will build the campaigns, write the ad copy, brief Design on creative, implement the tracking with Engineering support, and read the results yourself.

Analytical rigor is central to the role. A large share of this job is deciding what a number actually means: whether a CPA movement is signal or noise, whether a test has run long enough to read, whether a platform's reported conversions reflect real revenue. The best people in this seat are comfortable being the one who says the data does not support that conclusion yet, and equally comfortable acting decisively once it does.

A significant part of this role is expansion. Paid channels are proliferating faster than most teams can evaluate them, and we want someone who can design a real test for a new platform, run it with discipline, and tell us honestly whether to scale it or kill it. That includes AI-native inventory like ChatGPT Ads, where the targeting and optimization levers are limited and results depend far more on offer clarity and clean measurement than on platform sophistication.

You will own how and where our paid budget gets deployed. Material shifts to the total go through an approval step, but the channel mix, the strategy behind it, and the calls about what we test and where we scale are yours to drive.

## **Who we are**

Remember when every step of launching your dream felt like a mountain? Debt loomed, the tax code was a cryptic puzzle, and building a rock-solid foundation seemed impossible. PRIME Corporate Services was forged from that very struggle - by entrepreneurs who knew there had to be a better way.

We are not just a faceless firm; we are a co-pilot for founders, operators, and business builders navigating the chaos of growth. We help cut through red tape, simplify complex systems, and help entrepreneurs structure their business for long-term financial freedom.

From entity structuring to tax strategy to business credit and funding, we don't just protect businesses - we help to scale them. Our team partners directly with high-growth entrepreneurs and affiliate partners to drive measurable outcomes; more leads, more revenue, and stronger businesses.

We deliver expert guidance and exceptional service at every stage of the business journey.

**Our Mission:** We aim to serve, advise, and support entrepreneurs every day.

- **Impact at scale:** Your work will shape the experience of thousands of entrepreneurs working with PRIME.

- **Modernization Mission:** You'll play a key role in bringing advanced tech, analytics, and discipline to a growing organization — setting the foundation for the next generation of PRIME's digital ecosystem.

 Description: 
 <p>PRIME Corporate Services is seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager to own paid customer acquisition across every channel we buy.</p>
 <p>Reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing, this person is accountable for the performance of our paid media program: Google Search, Meta, and the emerging channels we have not built yet. You will own the accounts day to day, run the testing roadmap, own the conversion tracking that tells us whether any of it worked, and decide where the next dollar should go.</p>
 <p>Accountability in this role does not stop at the booked consultation. Working closely with the Sales team, you are also responsible for the quality of the traffic we buy and the orders it ultimately produces. Volume that does not convert is not a win here, and a channel that looks efficient on cost per lead but poor on closed business is a problem you are expected to find and fix.</p>
 <p>This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will build the campaigns, write the ad copy, brief Design on creative, implement the tracking with Engineering support, and read the results yourself.</p>
 <p>Analytical rigor is central to the role. A large share of this job is deciding what a number actually means: whether a CPA movement is signal or noise, whether a test has run long enough to read, whether a platform's reported conversions reflect real revenue. The best people in this seat are comfortable being the one who says the data does not support that conclusion yet, and equally comfortable acting decisively once it does.</p>
 <p>A significant part of this role is expansion. Paid channels are proliferating faster than most teams can evaluate them, and we want someone who can design a real test for a new platform, run it with discipline, and tell us honestly whether to scale it or kill it. That includes AI-native inventory like ChatGPT Ads, where the targeting and optimization levers are limited and results depend far more on offer clarity and clean measurement than on platform sophistication.</p>
 <p>You will own how and where our paid budget gets deployed. Material shifts to the total go through an approval step, but the channel mix, the strategy behind it, and the calls about what we test and where we scale are yours to drive.</p>
 <h2><b> Who we are</b></h2>
 <p>Remember when every step of launching your dream felt like a mountain? Debt loomed, the tax code was a cryptic puzzle, and building a rock-solid foundation seemed impossible. PRIME Corporate Services was forged from that very struggle - by entrepreneurs who knew there had to be a better way.</p>
 <p>We are not just a faceless firm; we are a co-pilot for founders, operators, and business builders navigating the chaos of growth. We help cut through red tape, simplify complex systems, and help entrepreneurs structure their business for long-term financial freedom.</p>
 <p>From entity structuring to tax strategy to business credit and funding, we don't just protect businesses - we help to scale them. Our team partners directly with high-growth entrepreneurs and affiliate partners to drive measurable outcomes; more leads, more revenue, and stronger businesses.</p>
 <p>We deliver expert guidance and exceptional service at every stage of the business journey.</p>
 <p><b> Our Mission:</b> We aim to serve, advise, and support entrepreneurs every day.</p>
 <h2><b> Why You'll Love Working Here</b></h2>
 <ul>
  <li><b> Impact at scale:</b> Your work will shape the experience of thousands of entrepreneurs working with PRIME.</li>
  <li><b> Autonomy + Accountability:</b> You'll be trusted to lead, experiment, and deliver results — no micromanagement, just momentum.</li>
  <li><b> Collaborative Culture:</b> You'll work alongside creative thinkers, engineers, and business leaders who care deeply about customer success and innovation.</li>
  <li><b> Modernization Mission:</b> You'll play a key role in bringing advanced tech, analytics, and discipline to a growing organization — setting the foundation for the next generation of PRIME's digital ecosystem.</li>
 </ul>

  <li>Impact-Driven Culture - Small team, big mission</li>

 <p><b> Channel Management</b></p>
 <ul>
  <li>Own day-to-day management of Google Search, Performance Max, and Demand Gen campaigns, plus Meta campaigns across acquisition and retargeting</li>
  <li>Own account architecture: campaign hierarchy, naming conventions, and account isolation across the Google Ads MCC and parallel Microsoft Advertising structure</li>
  <li>Own keyword strategy, match type mix, search term mining, and negative keyword management</li>

Description:


PRIME Corporate Services is seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager to own paid customer acquisition across every channel we buy.

Reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing, this person is accountable for the performance of our paid media program: Google Search, Meta, and the emerging channels we have not built yet. You will own the accounts day to day, run the testing roadmap, own the conversion tracking that tells us whether any of it worked, and decide where the next dollar should go.

Accountability in this role does not stop at the booked consultation. Working closely with the Sales team, you are also responsible for the quality of the traffic we buy and the orders it ultimately produces. Volume that does not convert is not a win here, and a channel that looks efficient on cost per lead but poor on closed business is a problem you are expected to find and fix.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will build the campaigns, write the ad copy, brief Design on creative, implement the tracking with Engineering support, and read the results yourself.

Analytical rigor is central to the role. A large share of this job is deciding what a number actually means: whether a CPA movement is signal or noise, whether a test has run long enough to read, whether a platform's reported conversions reflect real revenue. The best people in this seat are comfortable being the one who says the data does not support that conclusion yet, and equally comfortable acting decisively once it does.

A significant part of this role is expansion. Paid channels are proliferating faster than most teams can evaluate them, and we want someone who can design a real test for a new platform, run it with discipline, and tell us honestly whether to scale it or kill it. That includes AI-native inventory like ChatGPT Ads, where the targeting and optimization levers are limited and results depend far more on offer clarity and clean measurement than on platform sophistication.

You will own how and where our paid budget gets deployed. Material shifts to the total go through an approval step, but the channel mix, the strategy behind it, and the calls about what we test and where we scale are yours to drive.

## **Who we are**

Remember when every step of launching your dream felt like a mountain? Debt loomed, the tax code was a cryptic puzzle, and building a rock-solid foundation seemed impossible. PRIME Corporate Services was forged from that very struggle - by entrepreneurs who knew there had to be a better way.

We are not just a faceless firm; we are a co-pilot for founders, operators, and business builders navigating the chaos of growth. We help cut through red tape, simplify complex systems, and help entrepreneurs structure their business for long-term financial freedom.

From entity structuring to tax strategy to business credit and funding, we don't just protect businesses - we help to scale them. Our team partners directly with high-growth entrepreneurs and affiliate partners to drive measurable outcomes; more leads, more revenue, and stronger businesses.

We deliver expert guidance and exceptional service at every stage of the business journey.

**Our Mission:** We aim to serve, advise, and support entrepreneurs every day.

## **Why You'll Love Working Here**

- **Impact at scale:** Your work will shape the experience of thousands of entrepreneurs working with PRIME.
- **Autonomy + Accountability:** You'll be trusted to lead, experiment, and deliver results — no micromanagement, just momentum.
- **Collaborative Culture:** You'll work alongside creative thinkers, engineers, and business leaders who care deeply about customer success and innovation.
- **Modernization Mission:** You'll play a key role in bringing advanced tech, analytics, and discipline to a growing organization — setting the foundation for the next generation of PRIME's digital ecosystem.

 Description: 
 <p>PRIME Corporate Services is seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager to own paid customer acquisition across every channel we buy.</p>
 <p>Reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing, this person is accountable for the performance of our paid media program: Google Search, Meta, and the emerging channels we have not built yet. You will own the accounts day to day, run the testing roadmap, own the conversion tracking that tells us whether any of it worked, and decide where the next dollar should go.</p>
 <p>Accountability in this role does not stop at the booked consultation. Working closely with the Sales team, you are also responsible for the quality of the traffic we buy and the orders it ultimately produces. Volume that does not convert is not a win here, and a channel that looks efficient on cost per lead but poor on closed business is a problem you are expected to find and fix.</p>
 <p>This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will build the campaigns, write the ad copy, brief Design on creative, implement the tracking with Engineering support, and read the results yourself.</p>
 <p>Analytical rigor is central to the role. A large share of this job is deciding what a number actually means: whether a CPA movement is signal or noise, whether a test has run long enough to read, whether a platform's reported conversions reflect real revenue. The best people in this seat are comfortable being the one who says the data does not support that conclusion yet, and equally comfortable acting decisively once it does.</p>
 <p>A significant part of this role is expansion. Paid channels are proliferating faster than most teams can evaluate them, and we want someone who can design a real test for a new platform, run it with discipline, and tell us honestly whether to scale it or kill it. That includes AI-native inventory like ChatGPT Ads, where the targeting and optimization levers are limited and results depend far more on offer clarity and clean measurement than on platform sophistication.</p>
 <p>You will own how and where our paid budget gets deployed. Material shifts to the total go through an approval step, but the channel mix, the strategy behind it, and the calls about what we test and where we scale are yours to drive.</p>
 <h2><b> Who we are</b></h2>
 <p>Remember when every step of launching your dream felt like a mountain? Debt loomed, the tax code was a cryptic puzzle, and building a rock-solid foundation seemed impossible. PRIME Corporate Services was forged from that very struggle - by entrepreneurs who knew there had to be a better way.</p>
 <p>We are not just a faceless firm; we are a co-pilot for founders, operators, and business builders navigating the chaos of growth. We help cut through red tape, simplify complex systems, and help entrepreneurs structure their business for long-term financial freedom.</p>
 <p>From entity structuring to tax strategy to business credit and funding, we don't just protect businesses - we help to scale them. Our team partners directly with high-growth entrepreneurs and affiliate partners to drive measurable outcomes; more leads, more revenue, and stronger businesses.</p>
 <p>We deliver expert guidance and exceptional service at every stage of the business journey.</p>
 <p><b> Our Mission:</b> We aim to serve, advise, and support entrepreneurs every day.</p>
 <h2><b> Why You'll Love Working Here</b></h2>
 <ul>
  <li><b> Impact at scale:</b> Your work will shape the experience of thousands of entrepreneurs working with PRIME.</li>
  <li><b> Autonomy + Accountability:</b> You'll be trusted to lead, experiment, and deliver results — no micromanagement, just momentum.</li>

  <li>Own keyword strategy, match type mix, search term mining, and negative keyword management</li>

 <p><b> Testing and Analysis</b></p>
 <ul>
  <li>Maintain an always-on testing roadmap across audiences, creative, ad copy, offers, bid strategies, and landing pages</li>
  <li>Size tests so results are readable, evaluate them for statistical significance, and resist the pull to call a winner early</li>

  <li>Build your own analysis rather than waiting on a report from someone else, including pulling and reconciling data across ad platforms, GA4, and Salesforce</li>
  <li>Diagnose performance changes accurately, distinguishing platform volatility and seasonality from a real shift in the business</li>

 </ul>
 <p><b> New Channel Development</b></p>
 <ul>
  <li>Identify and evaluate new paid channels and placements against our ICP and unit economics</li>
  <li>Design channel tests with defined budgets, success criteria, and kill criteria established before any spend goes live</li>
  <li>Launch and learn in emerging inventory, including AI-native placements, where optimization levers are minimal and first-party data plus offer clarity carry the campaign</li>

 <p><b> Creative and Copy</b></p>
 <ul>

 </ul>
 <p><b> Measurement</b></p>
 <ul>
  <li>Own conversion tracking end to end with Engineering support, including Google Tag Manager, platform pixels and conversion APIs, and GA4 configuration</li>
  <li>Own offline conversion value passing from Salesforce back into the ad platforms so bidding algorithms optimize toward qualified pipeline and revenue rather than form fills</li>
  <li>Define and enforce UTM taxonomy across every campaign and channel</li>
  <li>Report on CPL, CPA, and CAC against target ceilings, and flag when a channel is drifting past them</li>

 <p><b> Budget and Planning</b></p>
 <ul>

 <ul>

  <li>Overall efficiency of paid spend, including the identification and elimination of waste</li>
  <li>Channel mix decisions and the quality of the reasoning behind them</li>
  <li>Accuracy and completeness of conversion tracking, and the integrity of the data flowing back into every ad platform</li>

  <li>Account hygiene and documentation, such that any competent marketer could pick up the accounts and understand them</li>
